basics.name: Paul Gilliam
basics.title: Senior Product Manager - AI-Native Platforms & Data-Driven Growth
basics.summary: Senior Product Manager with a track record of turning ambiguous, cross-functional problems into shipped platforms and measurable revenue growth. Personally contributed $6M+ in ARR growth at SmartMoving through a two-year ICP realignment and platform expansion, and now builds AI-native prototypes with Claude Code to validate enterprise data products before engineering resources are committed. Specializes in systematic customer discovery, GTM execution, and turning fragmented markets into coherent platform stories.

highlights: Personally contributed $6M+ in ARR growth at SmartMoving through a two-year ICP realignment, shifting the customer mix from 37% to 80% in ideal customer profile
Built a native ACH payments platform at SmartMoving contributing over $1M in ARR, and an OpenAPI ecosystem generating $100K in third-party integration revenue
Built and personally sold an analytics platform achieving 100% paid beta retention, earning a national Inc. Magazine Innovation Award
Used Claude Code to build a semantic layer at Capital One that cut delivery time from 3 months to 1 hour and reduced duplicate metrics by 30%, scaled across 4 lines of business
Established a systematic customer discovery program with 200+ cumulative customer interviews and monthly on-site visits uncovering opportunities competitors miss
Led platform consolidation strategy building a $1M special needs transportation platform serving 1,000+ students across 10+ districts with a 40-person contractor team
